name: @apiverve/visarequirements
description: Visa Requirements tells you what a passport holder needs to enter another country: no visa, an electronic travel authorization, an eVisa, a visa on arrival, a visa arranged in advance, or entry restricted. Paid plans add the allowed stay in days, every alternative route (an eVisa or a visa on arrival, say), a link to the official government portal for ETAs and eVisas, per-category counts for a passport and its full destination list.
